product_overview: LogiStock Solutions is a REST API backend for a Warehouse Management System providing JWT-based authentication, role-based user management, email notifications, and Wompi payment gateway integration. It exposes endpoints for account lifecycle, admin user/role operations, and secure payment handling (signature generation, webhook verification, transaction queries).
core_goals: Provide secure authentication (access + refresh tokens) with account lockout and login alerts.
Enforce role-based access control for administrative and warehouse operations.
Offer full user lifecycle management (profile, password change, deactivate) via protected APIs.
Integrate Wompi payments: generate integrity signatures, verify webhooks, and persist transactions.
Protect all sensitive routes with JWT and validate public webhooks using SHA-256 checksums.
Store audit data (login attempts, refresh tokens, payment transactions) for security and reconciliation.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Register CLIENT users, authenticate with access and refresh JWTs, refresh and revoke tokens. Enforce account lockout after repeated failed logins and send login alert emails on successful logins.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with {firstName, lastName, email, password, phone?} -> Receive 201 with {accessToken, refreshToken}
POST /api/auth/register with already-registered email -> Receive 409 Conflict with {message: 'Email already registered'}
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with {accessToken, refreshToken} (server sends login alert email)

POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Unauthorized (LoginAttempt recorded) -> Repeat failed POST /api/auth/login until 5 failures -> POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 401 Account locked
POST /api/auth/refresh with valid {refreshToken} -> Receive 200 with new {accessToken}
POST /api/auth/refresh with expired or revoked {refreshToken} -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/auth/logout with valid {refreshToken} -> Receive 200 {message: 'Logged out'} (refresh token revoked)
POST /api/auth/logout with invalid or already-revoked {refreshToken} -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: User Management
features.description: Profile and account administration: list users (ADMIN), view/update own profile, change password, and deactivate accounts (ADMIN). All /api/users routes require a Bearer access token.
user_flows: GET /api/users with Authorization: Bearer {adminAccessToken} -> Receive 200 with array of users (passwords omitted)
GET /api/users without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
GET /api/users/me with Authorization: Bearer {accessToken} -> Receive 200 with authenticated user's profile
GET /api/users/:id with Authorization: Bearer {accessToken} (requesting own id) -> Receive 200 with user profile
GET /api/users/:id with Authorization: Bearer {accessToken} (non-admin requesting another user's id) -> Receive 403 Forbidden
PUT /api/users/:id with Authorization: Bearer {accessToken} (own account) and body {firstName?, lastName?, phone?} -> Receive 200 with updated profile
PATCH /api/users/:id/password with Authorization: Bearer {accessToken} and body {currentPassword, newPassword} (own account) -> Receive 200 {message: 'Password changed'}
PATCH /api/users/:id/password with incorrect currentPassword -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
DELETE /api/users/:id with Authorization: Bearer {adminAccessToken} -> Receive 200 {message: 'User deactivated'} (isActive set to false)
DELETE /api/users/:id with non-admin Authorization -> Receive 403 Forbidden

features.name: Role Management
features.description: Expose system roles (admin, warehouse_manager, operator, client). All /api/roles routes require ADMIN role and a valid Bearer token.
user_flows: GET /api/roles with Authorization: Bearer {adminAccessToken} -> Receive 200 with array of roles
GET /api/roles with Authorization: Bearer {nonAdminAccessToken} -> Receive 403 Forbidden
GET /api/roles/:id with Authorization: Bearer {adminAccessToken} -> Receive 200 with role details
GET /api/roles/:id with invalid id and Authorization: Bearer {adminAccessToken} -> Receive 404 Not Found

features.name: Wompi Payment Gateway
features.description: Support Wompi integration: generate SHA-256 signatures for the frontend widget, receive and verify webhook events (public endpoint verified via checksum), persist and query transactions. Signature and transaction query endpoints require JWT.
user_flows: POST /api/wompi/signature with Authorization: Bearer {accessToken} and body {reference, amountInCents, currency} -> Receive 200 with {signature, publicKey}
POST /api/wompi/signature without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/wompi/webhook with Wompi event payload and valid SHA-256 checksum header -> Verify checksum -> Persist or update PaymentTransaction -> Receive 200 {received: true}
POST /api/wompi/webhook with invalid or missing checksum header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
GET /api/wompi/transactions/:id with Authorization: Bearer {accessToken} -> Receive 200 with transaction details (from DB / Wompi API)
GET /api/wompi/transactions/:id without Authorization -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

code_summary.description: REST API backend for a Warehouse Management System (WMS) built with Node.js, Express and TypeScript. Supports JWT authentication, role-based access control, email notifications via Resend, and payment processing via Wompi payment gateway.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Register new users with CLIENT role, login with JWT tokens, refresh access tokens, logout by revoking refresh tokens. Account lockout after 5 failed attempts. Login alert email on every login.

features.name: Role Management
features.description: List system roles (admin, warehouse_manager, operator, client).

features.name: Wompi Payment Gateway
features.description: Generates SHA-256 integrity signatures for the Wompi widget. Receives and verifies webhook events. Persists all transactions to DB.

models.RefreshToken: id, userId, token, expiresAt, isRevoked, ipAddress, userAgent

models.LoginAttempt: id, userId, email, success, ipAddress, userAgent, attemptedAt

security: JWT Bearer token required on all /api/users and /api/roles routes
